notes_for_editor: Thin record. Two lookout lists give name, county, position and status only; the Forest Lookouts list names the tower with Mecklenburg first and Baskerville in brackets, while the Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives Baskerville first, with Mecklenburg in brackets. Record name 'Baskerville (Mecklenburg)' matches the association list. No builder, date, design, height, staffing, fire history or photo found in the local caches or two web searches; no registry number. The Virginia Department of Forestry history page is general context and does not name this tower. Story is about 100 words, below the usual 120 because the evidence does not support more.
